task_completion.description: The Subsurface application is open and a dive is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface main window is visible with a dive profile graph displayed in the center or bottom pane.

task_completion.description: The agent accesses the configuration menu or preferences to find overlay settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A context menu (right-click on profile) or the Preferences dialog (specifically the 'Display' or 'Graph' tab) is visible.

task_completion.description: The 'Tissue heat map' option is toggled on.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkmark next to 'Tissue heat map' in a menu, or a checked box in the Preferences window.

task_completion.description: The 'Average depth' (or 'Mean depth') option is toggled on.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkmark next to 'Average depth' or 'Show mean depth' in the settings or context menu.

task_completion.description: The Tissue heat map is visually rendered on the profile graph.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The background of the dive profile graph shows a multi-colored gradient (typically green/yellow/red) representing tissue loading.

task_completion.description: The Average depth line is visually rendered on the profile graph.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A horizontal dashed or solid line representing the average depth is visible across the dive profile.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface rather than command-line configuration editing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement, menu clicks, or dialog interactions within the Subsurface GUI.

integrity.description: The overlays are part of the software UI, not manually drawn or edited onto the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The overlays (heatmap and line) align perfectly with the graph axes and dive data points.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Subsurface application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The window decorations, icons, and dive data are consistent with the Subsurface software environment.

privileged_info_for_vlm: In Subsurface, the 'Tissue heat map' adds a colorful background gradient to the profile graph. The 'Average depth' (sometimes labeled 'Mean depth') adds a horizontal line. These can be enabled via a right-click context menu on the profile graph or through the Preferences > Display/Graph settings. The heatmap is distinct from the simple blue fill of the water column.
